subject: NorthStar GTM & Ops handoff for marketplace listing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northstar.ai>, Partners Team <partners@northstar.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: NorthStar GTM & Ops handoff for marketplace listing

Hi Elena / NorthStar partners —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to get NorthStar listed in the Redwood Cloud Marketplace. This thread is to capture the technical handoff, operational asks, and timing so both teams are aligned before we open the listing request.

High-level asks from our side (please confirm feasibility):
- Technical: minimal integration for single-sign provisioning + billing attribution tag (see attached MVP spreadsheet). Can Integratech support a lightweight connector (API keys + webhook) within 4–6 weeks?
- Product: we need a clear feature matrix (what's included in the marketplace SKU vs. premium add-ons). Karthik, can you do a short feature mapping?
- Legal/Contract: Redwood requires a Marketplace MSA + standard data processing addendum. If you have counter-redlines, please share at a single consolidated PDF.

I've attached a starter requirements sheet (northstar_mvp_requirements.xlsx) and added our internal Jira link below.

Next steps proposal:
1) Elan/Partner team confirms technical owner + Integratech contact (if different) by EOD Mon 11/9.
2) Redwood product (Karthik) to provide SKU mapping by Thu 11/12.
3) Legal exchange of draft MSA redlines by Fri 11/13.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and any scheduling constraints.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: northstar_mvp_requirements.xlsx

Thanks Jordan — looping in Tom from Integratech who will be our implementation lead for the connector.

Tom, can you confirm if the webhook + API key flow is something your team can deliver within the 4–6 week window? Also call out any operational constraints (rate limits, data residency restrictions).

We will consolidate legal redlines into a single PDF and send to Laura (cc'd by Jordan in follow-ups) next week.

Elena
VP, Partnerships — NorthStar Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@northstar.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthStar GTM & Ops handoff for marketplace listing

Jordan / Elena —

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick responses and a proposed SKU mapping to keep things concrete: (internal notes bolded for clarity)

1) Timing — 4–6 weeks looks feasible for a minimal connector (Integratech to confirm). We should budget one engineering sprint from Redwood side for publisher onboarding + e2e tests.

2) Proposed SKU mapping (summary):
- Marketplace Basic (listed SKU) — includes hosted connector, single-sign provisioning via SSO, standard billing attribution tags. (Goal: out-of-the-box for most customers)
- Marketplace Pro (add-on) — advanced telemetry export, custom model packaging, priority support (charged as add-on SKU).
- Enterprise (off-catalog) — dedicated deployment & custom SLAs (sales-assisted).

3) Product asks / integration details (Elena/Tom please confirm):
- API endpoints needed: /v1/subscribe, /v1/usage-events, /v1/webhook/attribution
- Billing tag must support a 64-char freeform field and an ISO8601 timestamp for usage events.
- Data retention: default 30 days for marketplace logs; customers may request longer with enterprise contract.

4) Ops and rollout risks:
- If Integratech's webhook delivery retries are >24 hours, we need a queued fallback at Redwood to avoid missing attribution events.
- SSO metadata exchange: provide cert and ACS URL to our onboarding tool.

Attachments: I updated the northstar_mvp_requirements.xlsx with the SKU draft and endpoints. Ben — please add any infra implications.

Next steps I recommend:
- Tom confirms API contract and rough ETA by Tue 11/10.
- Elena consolidates legal redlines and sends to Laura Bennett (cc'd on future mails).
- Jordan to open a Marketplace Request ticket (I can help define the acceptance criteria).

Karthik
Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northstar.ai>, Partners Team <partners@northstar.ai>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@integratech.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NorthStar GTM & Ops handoff for marketplace listing

Looping in Laura for legal and final ops checkpoint. Quick infra readout from my side:

- Infra impact: low for marketplace basic. We will provision a namespaced ingestion endpoint for NorthStar and a staging webhook URL for integration testing. No dedicated GPUs or special kernel work required for MVP.
- Observability: we need a telemetry contract (events schema) before going to production. Karthik, please add the events schema to the Jira ticket.
- Billing: Redwood supports the 64-char attribution field; I'll confirm that it's passed end-to-end in the billing pipeline.

Laura — friendly ask: can Legal review the attached draft_msa_redlines.pdf and call out any non-standard obligations (data residency, indemnities, export controls) by EOD Fri 11/13? If acceptable, we can proceed with Marketplace Request submission on Mon 11/16.

Proposed owner/owners:
- Tech owner: Tom Reeves / Integratech
- Product owner: Karthik Iyer / Redwood
- Contract owner: Laura Bennett / Redwood and Elena Soto / NorthStar

Ben Carter
Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
